preConditions.onFailMessage: 新闻网专用模板存在重复或不兼容配置，请检查现场数据；禁止覆盖历史模板。
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM `t_biz_access_template` WHERE `template_name` = 'IKKYLJ_甘肃中医药新闻网'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `t_biz_access_template` WHERE `template_name` = 'IKKYLJ_甘肃中医药新闻网' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(`remark`, ''), '__NULL__') <> 'IKKYLJ：甘肃中医药大学新闻网专用字段映射，不修改其他模板'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT f.`field_name` FROM `t_biz_access_field` f JOIN `t_biz_access_template` t ON t.`id` = f.`template_id` WHERE t.`template_name` = 'IKKYLJ_甘肃中医药新闻网' GROUP BY f.`template_id`, f.`field_name` HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_fields

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `t_biz_access_field` f JOIN `t_biz_access_template` t ON t.`id` = f.`template_id` LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'WZMC' AS `field_name`, '网站名称' AS `field_c_name`, '网站名称' AS `access_field_name`, NULL AS `convert_type`, NULL AS `convert_value`, 1 AS `orderd`, 0 AS `is_order_field`, 0 AS `order_type` UNION ALL SELECT 'WZYM', '网站域名', '网站域名', NULL, NULL, 2, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'SSLM', '所属栏目', '所属栏目', NULL, NULL, 3, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZTM', '标题', '标题', NULL, NULL, 4, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'WZ', '网址', '网址', NULL, NULL, 5, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZRBJ', '编辑', '编辑', NULL, NULL, 6, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'FBSJ', '发布时间', '发布时间', NULL, NULL, 7, 1, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ', '作者', '作者', NULL, NULL, 8, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZY', '摘要', '摘要', NULL, NULL, 9, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'JTXWNR', '具体新闻内容', '具体新闻内容', NULL, NULL, 10, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'CJSJ', '采集时间', '采集时间', NULL, NULL, 11, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'CJR', '采集人', '采集人', 'fixed', '档案馆', 12, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'LAIY', '来源', '来源', NULL, NULL, 13, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ND', '年度', '年度', NULL, NULL, 14, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'SSLMBH', '所属栏目编号', '所属栏目编号', NULL, NULL, 15, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'FLH', '分类号', '分类号', NULL, NULL, 16, 0, 0 ) e ON e.`field_name` = f.`field_name` WHERE t.`template_name` = 'IKKYLJ_甘肃中医药新闻网' AND (e.`field_name` IS NULL OR COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`field_c_name`, ''), '__NULL__') <> e.`field_c_name` OR COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`access_field_name`, ''), '__NULL__') <> e.`access_field_name` OR COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`access_field_c_name`, ''), '__NULL__') <> e.`field_c_name` OR COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`convert_type`, ''), '__NULL__') <> COALESCE(NULLIF(e.`convert_type`, ''), '__NULL__') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(f.`convert_value`, ''), '__NULL__') <> COALESCE(NULLIF(e.`convert_value`, ''), '__NULL__'))

changeSet.comment: 初始化三个归档栏目的独立字段模板，分类号直接传入 WY11、WY12、WY13，保留既有模板与迁移历史。
changeSet.sql:
-- 不绑定现场库、标签或全宗编号，正式业务接口在部署时完成建库建表及授权。 INSERT INTO `t_biz_access_template` (`template_name`, `remark`, `create_time`) SELECT 'IKKYLJ_甘肃中医药新闻网', 'IKKYLJ：甘肃中医药大学新闻网专用字段映射，不修改其他模板', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `t_biz_access_template` WHERE `template_name` = 'IKKYLJ_甘肃中医药新闻网' );
-- 空转换类型沿用系统直接映射语义，禁止写入未支持的转换名称。 INSERT INTO `t_biz_access_field` ( `template_id`, `field_name`, `field_c_name`, `access_field_name`, `access_field_c_name`, `convert_type`, `convert_value`, `orderd`, `is_order_field`, `order_type`, `remark`, `create_time` ) SELECT t.`id`, e.`field_name`, e.`field_c_name`, e.`access_field_name`, e.`field_c_name`, e.`convert_type`, e.`convert_value`, e.`orderd`, e.`is_order_field`, e.`order_type`, 'IKKYLJ 新闻网专用映射', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM `t_biz_access_template` t CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 'WZMC' AS `field_name`, '网站名称' AS `field_c_name`, '网站名称' AS `access_field_name`, NULL AS `convert_type`, NULL AS `convert_value`, 1 AS `orderd`, 0 AS `is_order_field`, 0 AS `order_type` UNION ALL SELECT 'WZYM', '网站域名', '网站域名', NULL, NULL, 2, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'SSLM', '所属栏目', '所属栏目', NULL, NULL, 3, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZTM', '标题', '标题', NULL, NULL, 4, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'WZ', '网址', '网址', NULL, NULL, 5, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZRBJ', '编辑', '编辑', NULL, NULL, 6, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'FBSJ', '发布时间', '发布时间', NULL, NULL, 7, 1, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ', '作者', '作者', NULL, NULL, 8, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ZY', '摘要', '摘要', NULL, NULL, 9, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'JTXWNR', '具体新闻内容', '具体新闻内容', NULL, NULL, 10, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'CJSJ', '采集时间', '采集时间', NULL, NULL, 11, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'CJR', '采集人', '采集人', 'fixed', '档案馆', 12, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'LAIY', '来源', '来源', NULL, NULL, 13, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ND', '年度', '年度', NULL, NULL, 14, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'SSLMBH', '所属栏目编号', '所属栏目编号', NULL, NULL, 15, 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'FLH', '分类号', '分类号', NULL, NULL, 16, 0, 0 ) e LEFT JOIN `t_biz_access_field` f ON f.`template_id` = t.`id` AND f.`field_name` = e.`field_name` WHERE t.`template_name` = 'IKKYLJ_甘肃中医药新闻网' AND f.`id` IS NULL;
